metaDescription: Book a technical scoping call with Techlio. Reply within 24 hours, NDA available, offices in the USA and Pakistan.
heroTitle: Bring the problem. *Leave with a plan.*
heroIntro: Send a few lines about what you are building. Within 24 hours a senior engineer replies with questions, a first read on approach and times for a call.

faqs.question: What happens after I send the form?
faqs.answer: A senior engineer reads it and replies within 24 hours with questions and times for a free 30-minute scoping call. After a focused discovery you receive a proposal with scope, timeline and approach before any code is written.

faqs.question: Can we sign an NDA first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tick the NDA box and we send a mutual NDA before the call. We are also happy to sign yours.

faqs.question: Do you work with early-stage startups or only enterprises?
faqs.answer: Both. We work with early-stage AI startups and with established enterprises, and the engagement is sized to match.

faqs.question: We are not sure we are ready for AI. Is a call still useful?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer a free AI readiness assessment that reviews your stack, workflows and goals and tells you plainly where AI would and would not help.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you build on?
faqs.answer: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, with generative AI, LLM integration and custom application development on top.
